summary.text: Rachel Grage is the Democratic nominee for Florida's 5th Congressional District. She describes herself as an engineer, health care professional, and mother of four, with engineering degrees from Tulane University. She ran for the Florida House in 2024 and is running on affordability, accountability, and protecting individual rights.

paragraphs.text: Earned bachelor's and master's degrees in engineering from Tulane University.
Worked as a biomedical engineer focused on improving health outcomes.
Has been affiliated with Catholic Charities, Equality Florida, and the Democratic Women's Club of Florida; says she has advocated on issues affecting Florida families.
Ran as the Democratic nominee for Florida House District 16 in 2024 and lost to incumbent Kiyan Michael, 39.3% to 60.7%.
Won the August 18, 2026 Democratic primary for the 5th District with 65.1% of the vote against Alexander Hazen and Mark Heggestad; describes herself as a mother of four.
